title: JET 歐洲聯合環
summary: JET 位於英國卡勒姆，1983 年產生第一個電漿，2023 年 12 月結束運轉，是唯一長期使用氘氚燃料的大型托卡馬克；1997 年創下 16.1 MW 的融合功率，2023 年的最後一輪氘氚實驗在 5 秒內產生 69 MJ。課程定量分析這些紀錄、以飛輪供應脈衝電力、類 ITER 壁的遙控安裝，以及三乘積。
summaryEn: JET at Culham in Britain made its first plasma in 1983 and ended operation in December 2023, the only large tokamak to use deuterium-tritium fuel over a long period; it set 16.1 MW of fusion power in 1997, and the last deuterium-tritium campaign in 2023 produced 69 MJ in 5 seconds. The course quantifies these records, pulsed power from flywheels, remote installation of the ITER-like wall, and the triple product.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 四十年的歐洲聯合環：氘氚能量紀錄、飛輪發電機、類 ITER 壁與遙控操作
v30FocusEn: Forty years of the Joint European Torus: deuterium-tritium energy records, flywheel generators, the ITER-like wall and remote handling

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：JET 歐洲聯合環
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: JET Joint European Torus
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「融合增益 Q」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Device size and plasma volume" and "Fusion gain Q": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Device size and plasma volume" is correct?
options: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。
融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。
Q 大於 1 就表示這座裝置已經可以發電賣錢。
optionsEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio.
Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size.
Q greater than 1 means the device can already sell electricity.
quiz.explanation: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」如何決定「JET 歐洲聯合環」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Device size and plasma volume” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “JET Joint European Torus”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。電漿體積大致與 R·a² 成正比，並因截面拉長而增大。體積越大，表面積對體積的比越小，能量越不容易流失，這是融合裝置必須做得很大的根本原因；球形托卡馬克則以很小的長寬比換取較高的比壓。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. Plasma volume scales roughly with R·a² and grows with elongation. A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：大半徑約 2.96 m，1983 年 6 月 25 日產生第一個電漿
steps.observationEn: Project file: Major radius is about 2.96 m, and first plasma was on 25 June 1983
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Device size and plasma volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Plasma volume scales roughly with R·a² and grows with elongation. A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta.

quiz.question: 依「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的模型 V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ，以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ for "Device size and plasma volume", which value is closest to the plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section?
options: 153 m³
optionsEn: 153 m³
quiz.explanation: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 2.96 m、a = 1.25 m、κ = 1.68，得 153 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 2.96 m, a = 1.25 m, κ = 1.68 the result is 153 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Device size and plasma volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 2.96 m、a = 1.25 m、κ = 1.68，得 153 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 a 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 2.96 m, a = 1.25 m, κ = 1.68 the result is 153 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise a by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 186 m³（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 186 m³ (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 153 m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 a 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 153 m³ (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in a with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 2.96 m、a = 1.25 m、κ = 1.68，得 153 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。
knowledge.textEn: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 2.96 m, a = 1.25 m, κ = 1.68 the result is 153 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 186 m³（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 186 m³ (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Device size and plasma volume"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
遙控機械手很靈巧，任何組件都可以拿來裝。
由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Remote manipulators are so dexterous that any component can be fitted.

Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel.
quiz.explanation: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Device size and plasma volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次放電的平衡重建結果要與控制系統的即時估算比對並存檔，作為判斷診斷漂移與控制裕度的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Equilibrium reconstructions of each discharge should be compared with real-time control estimates and archived as the basis for judging diagnostic drift and control margin.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: When "Device size and plasma volume" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。

Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Device size and plasma volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「JET 歐洲聯合環」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “JET Joint European Torus”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積越大，表面積對體積的比越小，能量越不容易流失，這是融合裝置必須做得很大的根本原因；球形托卡馬克則以很小的長寬比換取較高的比壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。
knowledge.textEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fusion gain Q" is correct?
options: Q 大於 1 就表示這座裝置已經可以發電賣錢。
只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。
融合增益 Q 定義為融合功率除以注入電漿的外部加熱功率。
optionsEn: Q greater than 1 means the device can already sell electricity.
With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit.
Fusion gain Q is fusion power divided by external heating power injected into the plasma.
quiz.explanation: 融合增益 Q 定義為融合功率除以注入電漿的外部加熱功率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fusion gain Q is fusion power divided by external heating power injected into the plasma. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 融合增益 Q：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Fusion gain Q: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「融合增益 Q」如何決定「JET 歐洲聯合環」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fusion gain Q” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “JET Joint European Torus”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 融合增益 Q 定義為融合功率除以注入電漿的外部加熱功率。Q = 1 稱為科學損益兩平；Q = 5 時氘氚反應產生的阿爾發粒子加熱與外部加熱相當；Q 趨近無限大即點火。要注意這是電漿層級的增益：算上加熱系統效率、磁體低溫與廠用電，並把熱轉成電之後，電廠要有淨輸出，電漿增益需要遠高於 10。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fusion gain Q is fusion power divided by external heating power injected into the plasma. Q = 1 is scientific breakeven; at Q = 5 alpha-particle heating from deuterium–tritium reactions equals external heating; Q approaching infinity is ignition. This is gain at plasma level: after heating-system efficiency, magnet cryogenics, house loads and heat-to-electricity conversion, a power plant needs plasma gain far above 10 for net output. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：1997 年以約 24 MW 的加熱功率產生 16.1 MW 的融合功率，Q 約 0.67
steps.observationEn: Project file: In 1997 about 24 MW of heating produced 16.1 MW of fusion power, Q of about 0.67
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Q 大於 1 就表示這座裝置已經可以發電賣錢。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Q greater than 1 means the device can already sell electricity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「融合增益 Q」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Fusion gain Q”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 融合增益 Q
knowledge.text: 融合增益 Q 定義為融合功率除以注入電漿的外部加熱功率。Q = 1 稱為科學損益兩平；Q = 5 時氘氚反應產生的阿爾發粒子加熱與外部加熱相當；Q 趨近無限大即點火。要注意這是電漿層級的增益：算上加熱系統效率、磁體低溫與廠用電，並把熱轉成電之後，電廠要有淨輸出，電漿增益需要遠高於 10。
knowledge.textEn: Fusion gain Q is fusion power divided by external heating power injected into the plasma. Q = 1 is scientific breakeven; at Q = 5 alpha-particle heating from deuterium–tritium reactions equals external heating; Q approaching infinity is ignition. This is gain at plasma level: after heating-system efficiency, magnet cryogenics, house loads and heat-to-electricity conversion, a power plant needs plasma gain far above 10 for net output.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：Q 大於 1 就表示這座裝置已經可以發電賣錢。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Q greater than 1 means the device can already sell electricity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 1997 年以約 24 MW 的加熱功率產生 16.1 MW 的融合功率，Q 約 0.67
knowledge.textEn: In 1997 about 24 MW of heating produced 16.1 MW of fusion power, Q of about 0.67

quiz.question: 依「融合增益 Q」的模型 Q = P_fus / P_aux，融合功率與外部加熱功率之比最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = P_fus / P_aux for "Fusion gain Q", which value is closest to the ratio of fusion power to external heating power?
quiz.explanation: Q = P_fus / P_aux；代入 Pfus = 16.1 MW、Paux = 24 MW，得 0.67（融合功率與外部加熱功率之比）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = P_fus / P_aux; with Pfus = 16.1 MW, Paux = 24 MW the result is 0.67 (ratio of fusion power to external heating power). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 融合增益 Q：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fusion gain Q: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融合增益 Q」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Fusion gain Q” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = P_fus / P_aux；代入 Pfus = 16.1 MW、Paux = 24 MW，得 0.67（融合功率與外部加熱功率之比）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Paux 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = P_fus / P_aux; with Pfus = 16.1 MW, Paux = 24 MW the result is 0.67 (ratio of fusion power to external heating power). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Paux by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Paux 增加 10% 時，結果變為 0.61（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Paux by 10% changes the result to 0.61 (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 0.67（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Paux 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 0.67 (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Paux with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = P_fus / P_aux；代入 Pfus = 16.1 MW、Paux = 24 MW，得 0.67（融合功率與外部加熱功率之比）。
knowledge.textEn: Q = P_fus / P_aux; with Pfus = 16.1 MW, Paux = 24 MW the result is 0.67 (ratio of fusion power to external heating power).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Paux 增加 10% 時，結果變為 0.61（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Paux by 10% changes the result to 0.61 (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「融合增益 Q」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fusion gain Q"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
融合功率由絕對校正過的中子產額量測（活化箔、分裂腔）乘以每次反應的能量求得；加熱功率則須扣除未被電漿吸收的部分（如中性束穿透損失）。
只要溫度達到一億度，就代表融合已經成功。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Fusion power comes from absolutely calibrated neutron yield, measured with activation foils and fission chambers, times energy per reaction.
Reaching a hundred million degrees means fusion has succeeded.
quiz.explanation: 融合功率由絕對校正過的中子產額量測（活化箔、分裂腔）乘以每次反應的能量求得；加熱功率則須扣除未被電漿吸收的部分（如中性束穿透損失）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fusion power comes from absolutely calibrated neutron yield, measured with activation foils and fission chambers, times energy per reaction; heating power must exclude what the plasma does not absorb, such as neutral-beam shine-through. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 融合增益 Q：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fusion gain Q: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融合增益 Q」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fusion gain Q” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 融合功率由絕對校正過的中子產額量測（活化箔、分裂腔）乘以每次反應的能量求得；加熱功率則須扣除未被電漿吸收的部分（如中性束穿透損失）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fusion power comes from absolutely calibrated neutron yield, measured with activation foils and fission chambers, times energy per reaction; heating power must exclude what the plasma does not absorb, such as neutral-beam shine-through. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何增益數字都要標明分母的定義（吸收功率、注入功率或電網功率）與積分時間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every gain figure should state the definition of its denominator — absorbed, injected or grid power — and the integration time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把注入功率誤用成「電網取電功率」或反之，Q 值會差好幾倍；媒體報導常混淆電漿增益與電廠淨增益。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing injected power with power drawn from the grid, or the reverse, changes Q several-fold; media reports often mix plasma gain with plant net gain. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 融合功率由絕對校正過的中子產額量測（活化箔、分裂腔）乘以每次反應的能量求得；加熱功率則須扣除未被電漿吸收的部分（如中性束穿透損失）。
knowledge.textEn: Fusion power comes from absolutely calibrated neutron yield, measured with activation foils and fission chambers, times energy per reaction; heating power must exclude what the plasma does not absorb, such as neutral-beam shine-through.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何增益數字都要標明分母的定義（吸收功率、注入功率或電網功率）與積分時間。
knowledge.textEn: Every gain figure should state the definition of its denominator — absorbed, injected or grid power — and the integration time.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA 融合設施安全相關技術文件。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA technical documents on safety of fusion facilities. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「融合增益 Q」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fusion gain Q" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
只要磁場夠強，電漿壓力可以無限提高。
若把注入功率誤用成「電網取電功率」或反之，Q 值會差好幾倍；媒體報導常混淆電漿增益與電廠淨增益。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
With a strong enough field, plasma pressure can be raised without limit.
Confusing injected power with power drawn from the grid, or the reverse, changes Q several-fold; media reports often mix plasma gain with plant net gain.
quiz.explanation: 若把注入功率誤用成「電網取電功率」或反之，Q 值會差好幾倍；媒體報導常混淆電漿增益與電廠淨增益。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing injected power with power drawn from the grid, or the reverse, changes Q several-fold; media reports often mix plasma gain with plant net gain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 融合增益 Q：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fusion gain Q: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融合增益 Q」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Fusion gain Q” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把注入功率誤用成「電網取電功率」或反之，Q 值會差好幾倍；媒體報導常混淆電漿增益與電廠淨增益。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「JET 歐洲聯合環」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing injected power with power drawn from the grid, or the reverse, changes Q several-fold; media reports often mix plasma gain with plant net gain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “JET Joint European Torus”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：要注意這是電漿層級的增益：算上加熱系統效率、磁體低溫與廠用電，並把熱轉成電之後，電廠要有淨輸出，電漿增益需要遠高於 10。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is gain at plasma level: after heating-system efficiency, magnet cryogenics, house loads and heat-to-electricity conversion, a power plant needs plasma gain far above 10 for net output.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Q 大於 1 就表示這座裝置已經可以發電賣錢。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Q greater than 1 means the device can already sell electricity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把注入功率誤用成「電網取電功率」或反之，Q 值會差好幾倍；媒體報導常混淆電漿增益與電廠淨增益。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing injected power with power drawn from the grid, or the reverse, changes Q several-fold; media reports often mix plasma gain with plant net gain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
